## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      2 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 03.09.2026 - 14.10.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _K_, 14.10.2026, 1/5: "After months of use the app suddenly changed and blocked all but 4 of my entries behind a paywall. Can't check, see or interact with them. Crazy work, but glad since it finally made me switch. App was always clunky, slow and stuttery but after setting everything up I didn't want to switch. bye"
            2. _Cara M_, 03.09.2026, 3/5: "Too much behind a paywall."
<!--/ir-theme-->
